summary: GAIA SENTINEL is an innovative environmental monitoring project designed to observe, analyze, and visualize environmental conditions in real time. Its main purpose is to provide accessible and reliable information about changes in the environment through technology, helping people understand environmental conditions and make informed decisions.
details:
The system consists of a solar-powered monitoring station with a lithium battery, an ESP32 microcontroller, an anemometer, and environmental sensors for measuring air, soil, and water conditions. It also includes a radio communication system and a central receiving tower.

The sensors collect environmental data, which is processed by the ESP32 and transmitted through radio communication to the central tower. From there, the information is sent to a dedicated website, where users can visualize real-time measurements, analyze graphs, and simulate different environmental scenarios, such as drought and atmospheric stress.
